horizon_relationship.linkage_method: One deliberately bundled structural adoption/growth/multiple regime plus separate shared AI-capability, core-execution, Base44-product-market-fit, unit-economics, and market-risk factors; factor-specific correlated checkpoint shocks; one starting diluted-share/net-claims state; and a sources-and-uses bridge tying claims reduction to retained owner FCFE and earnout remeasurement to the simulated Base44 ARR path. The target-date denominator is held flat because current awards are already included and future award vintages are charged explicitly in owner FCFF. There is no market-convergence forecast.
horizon_relationship.sensitivity_note: The formal distribution is target-date SOTP fair value; owner-FCFF DCF and cash multiples are non-voting cross-checks. Regime weights are structured judgments, not frequencies estimated from a historical base rate. With the same seed and 100,000 draws, moving ten probability points from platform-win to erosion (30% erosion / 58% defense / 12% platform-win) lowers the twelve-month median from $130.27 to $121.27 and mean from $132.52 to $118.62, while probability below the $87.62 reference rises from 19.5% to 28.7%. A separate 25% erosion / 65% defense / 10% platform case gives a $123.39 median and $120.44 mean. Moving the Base44 post-GP owner-cost load down/up by 15 points moves the formal twelve-month median to $136.53/$124.36, proving that unit economics affect the voting SOTP. The if-converted convention omits capped-call value through $267.89. Legacy contract fields named probability_loss_* mean probability that target-date fair value is 30%/50% below today's reference, not realized security loss.
